info.title: curb: a C# formatter driven by your .editorconfig
info.description: C# formatter with width-aware reflow while honouring the full IDE0055 .editorconfig option surface.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Exit non-zero if anything would change.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --files
options.description: [repeatable] Check only these, instead of walking path. May be given more than once. [default: null]

options.name: --msbuild-list-file
options.description:
What the MSBuild integration passes instead of files: a file listing one path
per line, since a project's compile set can be too long for a command line to hold directly. [default: null] [existing]

options.name: --cache
options.description: Skip files a previous run watched format to themselves. [default: null]

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: Skip re-parsing output to prove the token stream is unchanged.

options.name: --expand-unhandled
options.description: Benchmark-only cost model: pretend every syntax kind has a dedicated printer.

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Report which syntax kinds are still emitted verbatim.

options.name: --unformatted-list-file
options.description:
Write the paths that would change to this file, one per line. What the MSBuild integration reads
back to attach CURB0001 to each unformatted file instead of to the project. [default: null]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A file or directory to check. [default: .]

commands.name: cleanup
commands.description: Apply the code style fixes a build already reported.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --sarif-log
options.description:
[repeatable] The log to read, instead of searching path for
curb.sarif. May be given more than once, so a solution's per-project logs can all be
handed over in one run. [default: null]

options.name: --files
options.description: [repeatable] Restrict cleanup to these, instead of every file the logs mention. May be given more than once. [default: null]

options.name: --msbuild-list-file
options.description:
What the MSBuild integration passes instead of files: a file listing one path
per line, since a project's compile set can be too long for a command line to hold directly. [default: null] [existing]

options.name: --check
options.description: Report what would be fixed, change nothing.

options.name: --forward
options.description:
Hand what Curb cannot fix to dotnet format, scoped to the reported rules and files, and
report both timings.

options.name: --no-whitespace
options.description:
With forward, run dotnet format style and dotnet format analyzers
as two separate invocations instead of one bare dotnet format. The default runs whitespace
too, which is a no-op against Curb's own output, in exchange for loading the MSBuild workspace once
instead of twice.
Notes:  Cleanup never builds. Build first, then run it: dotnet build && curb cleanup.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Where to look for curb.sarif logs, and which files to clean. [default: .]
